name: hud_duel_surge_strip
description: The Surge on screen (design 1.4: both Holdfasts standing after wave 12, waves 9, 10 and 11 again, with +35% health, 8 s windows, frozen stipends and corks at half price), on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker. With both hollows moved to wave 12 in the first window, the strip names the window by the Surge, 'Surge 1/3', not 'Wave 12/12', and lists what its wave brings: wave 9's creeps. The Ready horn sounds the Surge's first wave (wave 13 of the match, the banner 'Surge 1/3'), still 'Surge 1/3' on the strip and the Holdfast's line. When both hollows clear it, the simulation's EV_SURGE opens the next window: the banner says 'The Surge 2/3 · wave 10 again', the strip 'Surge 2/3', the window counts down from 8 s, and the tray offers its packs at half of tier III's price, its tooltip saying stipends no longer grow; Ready is still asked for (the last wave is the Surge's third, not wave 12). Hovered, the wave list holds the Surge's waves, S1 to S3 with the creeps of the waves they repeat (not wave 12 again), and a fall in its second wave is told as 'Your Holdfast fell in Surge 2/3'.

steps.msg: both hollows to wave 12 in the first window: the next horn plays the Surge's first wave, whose clear opens window 14

steps.assert: Game.surge() == 1 and Game.surge_waves() == 3 and Game.last_wave() == 15 and node('Wave').text == 'Surge 1/3'
steps.msg: the window before the Surge: 'Surge 1/3' on the strip
the strip lists what the Surge's first wave brings: wave 9's creeps
the horn sounds the Surge's first wave: the banner and the strip say so

steps.assert: node('WaveList').visible and node('WaveRows').get_child_count() == 4 and node('SurgeHead').text == 'The Surge' and node('WaveRow12') == null
steps.msg: hovered, the wave list holds the Surge's line and its three waves, not wave 12, which is not played again
the running one marked, with wave 9's checks
the views name the match's waves 13 to 15 by the Surge
both cleared it: the Surge's second window

steps.assert: node('Wave').text == 'Surge 2/3' and node('BannerTitle').text == 'The Surge 2/3 · wave 10 again'
steps.msg: EV_SURGE: the banner and the strip say the Surge's second
its window counts down from 8 s

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').packs_shown().size() == 3 and node('DriftTray').packs_shown()[0]['price'] == 42 and Game.cork_price(14) == 42 and node('DriftTray').find_child('Tier', true, false).text == 'TIER III'
steps.msg: the tray offers the window's packs at half of tier III's 85

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').tip_shown()[1].contains('in the Surge stipends no longer grow') and node('DriftTray').tip_shown()[1].contains('42 gold')
steps.msg: its tooltip says stipends no longer grow
Ready is still asked for: the last wave is the Surge's third

steps.assert: Game.outcome() == 'lost' and Game.duel_rule_line() == 'Your Holdfast fell in Surge 2/3' and node('Hud').end_plate() == ['The Tide Took You', 'Your Holdfast fell in Surge 2/3']
steps.msg: a fall in the Surge's second wave is told by the Surge, not as wave 14
